failure_summary.description: The answer used a different number or a more specific label than the gold answer despite identifying the same concept.
The response added a role already given in the clue or omitted a distinguishing part of the context-supported name.
The agent repeated a named work instead of identifying the original work it reworks.

patch.reasoning: The existing exact-granularity rules already address the answer-form mismatches, so duplicating them is unwarranted. Add guidance for implicitly asking about the source of an adaptation or retelling, the remaining gap.

edits.content:
## Adaptation and source-work clues
- When an implicit clue names an adaptation, retelling, remake, or modernized work, check whether it is pointing to the original or source work. If context supports that relationship and the clue asks for the source, return the source work rather than repeating the named adaptation or giving its type or creator.
